messages:
Ava Morgan: FYI BrightLeaf (BL-231) reported an embed undercount on INV-2026-042 after an AZ failover at ~03:12 UTC. They say ~1.7k missing. Asking for provisional credit + investigation. @Ravi @Sofia
Ravi Patel: thanks. can we confirm whether this was ingestion loss or rate-limiter dedupe? any quick $ impact calc?
Ava Morgan: preliminary numbers: expected 18,942 vs stored 17,210 → 1,732 missing. Pricing tier $0.20/1k embeds → ~$0.35 credit. Query I ran: SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM embeddings_store WHERE customer_id='BL-231' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15' GROUP BY customer_id;
Joel Chen: infra note: AZ failover triggered retries; ip-based rate limiter had a 15s dedupe window and collapsed retries. We've updated limiter to a shorter window. Need cross-customer scan for that interval.
Sofia Li: finance action: GL-4420, memo: "Credit - embed undercount - INV-2026-042 - BrightLeaf". Proposed adjustment text: "Credit $0.35 to BrightLeaf (BL-231) for 1,732 missing embeddings. Root cause: AZ failover + rate limiter dedupe. Ticket FIN-3892."
FinOps Bot: Created FIN-3892: "BrightLeaf embed undercount during AZ failover" assigned to Ava Morgan. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/FIN-3892
Ravi Patel: provisional approve :white_check_mark: pending infra cross-customer scan. Ava, run the cluster-wide query and post results.
Ava Morgan: will do. I'll apply a provisional negative line on the invoice and follow up with a backfill/replay if we find rows. Sofia, please prepare GL entry and hold final close until scan done.
Sofia Li: ack — will prepare GL entry and post ledger id here when recorded.
Ava Morgan: leaving this thread as the audit trail.
